title: Alpha settings: experimental hype effects
summary: Settings has a new Alpha (experimental) page with six off-by-default toggles the user can try and rate: Air slow-mo (0.3× at the apex of big jumps, Freestyle only), Big-air camera (pull back and lower in big air, compresses on landing), Speed & air muffle (the soundtrack is muffled at speed and in big air, with a wind rush; it snaps back on landing), Apex sun glare, Landing burst (dust ring, dirt clods and a thump), and Heavy mud (faster dirt buildup, landing splats). None changes the recovered physics; slow motion only delays when the next fixed 1/60 s step runs.
details: unit tests in web/hype.test.mjs; a Rust menu test; a content browser test (tools/test_alpha_hype.mjs) that launches a real 24 ft jump on Caribou Peak and Sonora Dunes and measured slow motion at 0.3× (about 51–57 ms of real time per 60 Hz step), big-air framing, glare, muffle, a landing compression, about 45 burst particles, and mud rising. Arcade flips are in development separately and will join the page.
limitation: the audio muffle and thump were not listened to in automated runs; the glare has no occlusion; physical phones and controllers are untested; all tuning is a first pass awaiting the user's feedback. This is a host-verified checkpoint, not yet a verified public release.
